description:
Measure the gap or overlap on each axis between two placed nodes, or check that one face of many nodes lies on one plane. Finds facade gaps and modules that stand out. Changes nothing.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/measure"}

a.description: pair mode, first node: exact node path relative to the scene root, e.g. './Facade/Wall_01'.

axis.description: pair mode: report only this axis (x, y or z of the chosen space).

b.description: pair mode, second node: exact node path relative to the scene root, e.g. './Facade/Wall_01'.

face.description: plane mode: which face, e.g. '+z' for the face pointing along +z (a facade front that looks toward +z).

mode.description: pair: gap or overlap per axis between nodes a and b. plane: whether one face of every node in `nodes` lies on one plane.

nodes.description: plane mode: 2-32 nodes whose face is checked, e.g. every module of one facade line.

items.description: plane mode node: exact node path relative to the scene root, e.g. './Facade/Wall_01'.

scenePath.description: Exact scene to read or change, e.g. 'res://levels/street.tscn'. It must be open in the editor (any tab).

space.description: world: world axes. local: the axes of a (pair) or nodes[0] (plane), for rotated facades.

tolerance.description: Distance in scene units treated as touching (pair) or coplanar (plane). Default 5 mm.

name: summer_measure
title: Measure between nodes
